query: WITH legacy AS (SELECT o."operationDate" AS business_date, o."itemId" AS item_id, o."operationType" AS item_type, SUM(COALESCE(o."inOverrideQtyGrams", 0)::numeric) AS legacy_in FROM public.operations o WHERE o."operationType" IN ('production', 'packaging') AND COALESCE(o."inOverrideQtyGrams", 0)::numeric > 0 GROUP BY o."operationDate", o."itemId", o."operationType"), confirmed AS (SELECT p."purchaseDate" AS business_date, p."itemId" AS item_id, SUM(p."quantityGrams"::numeric) AS purchase_in FROM public.purchases p WHERE p.status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY p."purchaseDate", p."itemId") SELECT l.business_date, l.item_type, l.item_id, i.name, l.legacy_in, COALESCE(c.purchase_in, 0) AS purchase_in, l.legacy_in - COALESCE(c.purchase_in, 0) AS uncovered_in FROM legacy l JOIN public.items i ON i.id = l.item_id LEFT JOIN confirmed c ON c.business_date = l.business_date AND c.item_id = l.item_id WHERE l.legacy_in - COALESCE(c.purchase_in, 0) > 0 ORDER BY l.business_date, l.item_type, i."sortOrder" LIMIT 500
